messages:
elaine-sec: quick heads-up, scanner (clair) flagged CVE-2026-9999 in libssh inside base image debian-slim-2025-11. Suggest emergency rebuild + sign with KMS and a narrow canary. @devon-sre @sam-ops

devon-sre: ack. what's the exploitability and which services use this image?

elaine-sec: exploitability low-med (needs crafted input). Affected services: model-serving, batch-infer, staging. Will block new deploys referencing this tag and open PR for rebuild.

sam-ops: cosign/KMS notes: ensure ci-cosign SA has access to key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key and include key_version in annotation.

anne-sec: RBAC: keep grants minimal and timeboxed. storage.objects.create on staging bucket + iam.serviceAccounts.actAs for cosign runner; add expiry in infra-iam PR.

beth-plat: add audit fields: rebuild.trace_id, rebuild.reason, signing.key_version, cosign.digest -> route to splunk index image_rebuilds.

elaine-sec: plan: upgrade libssh -> 0.10.x, run fuzz against ssh parsing, run clair scan, sign to staging, smoke tests, then 5% canary for 30m. I'll open the PR now.

cosign-bot: Reminder: existing signed images remain verifiable until key revoke. New images should land in staging first.

devon-sre: I'll reserve tonight's maintenance window if sec sign-off arrives by EOD.

elaine-sec: will post fuzz results and PR link here.
